clanWar.title: Clan War
clanWar.heroDesc: Rules, rewards, and loss calculation based on the “War rules” screen.
clanWar.accessBullet1: The War screen is hidden from the menu; any section link (active wars, sending troops, claim history, archive) redirects to the home screen.
clanWar.accessBullet2: The clan card still shows: the win/loss counter, a declare-war button, and a list of completed wars older than 6 hours — without personal rewards.
clanWar.accessBullet3: Personal reward claim for war participation is unreachable by any available means.
clanWar.winBullet1: 100% of resources from enemy troop losses
clanWar.lossBullet3: Low enemy losses may yield no rewards
clanWar.rule1: The clan founder or their deputies can start a war.
clanWar.rule3: Only clans with at least 90% of the attacker’s power can be targeted.
clanWar.rule4: Both clans must have at least 5 members to participate.
clanWar.rule5: When the war starts, 5% of enemy troops in castles are auto-called.
clanWar.rule6: Defense value is hidden for the first 3 hours after the war starts.
clanWar.rule7: You can send unlimited troops at any time until the war ends.
clanWar.rule8: Only members who joined before the war started can send troops and be called.
clanWar.rule9: Participants receive rewards based on contribution.
clanWar.winningBullet1: Receives 100% of resources from the opponent’s lost troops.
clanWar.losingBullet2: If the losing clan sent less than 50% of its total power, it is considered a surrender.
clanWar.losingBullet3: On surrender, participants lose 50% of their daily energy (minimum 2 energy remains).
clanWar.losingBullet4: Additional surrender penalties will be added in the future.
clanWar.moreRewardsBullet1: Both sides get EXP, stars, and card chests depending on the opponent’s troop losses.
clanWar.moreRewardsBullet2: Star level depends on player level: 1–9 → level 1, 10–19 → level 2, etc.
clanWar.moreRewardsBullet3: Level 35+ has a higher chance to receive a chest with level 4–5 cards.
clanWar.moreRewardsBullet5: Low damage or low enemy losses may yield no rewards.
clanWar.lossCalcBullet1: Total losses = 20%, split by the ratio of the opponent’s power.
clanWar.uiBullet1: “War in progress” screen with timer and progress bar.
clanWar.uiBullet2: Clan card: level, founder, clan power, members, wins/losses, membership requirements.
clanWar.uiBullet4: War history and “Recent wars” (ended 6+ hours ago).
